• Move with the arrows on your remote and press OK to open an app.\n• Press Back at any time to return to Google TV. Google TV stays installed and untouched.\n• Settings (the last tile, or the Menu button) takes you back to Google TV or uninstalls CinematicTV.
CinematicTV is your Home app. To undo it, open App info and choose Clear defaults, or uninstall CinematicTV.
On this device the Home button always opens Google TV. Changing that would mean disabling system apps, which CinematicTV never does, so open CinematicTV from your Apps row instead.
This device lets you choose CinematicTV as your Home app. You can undo it at any time.
To use CinematicTV as Home, press Home on your remote and choose CinematicTV if Android asks.
